SELECT 
    vendor_email, 
    MAX(vendor_name) AS vendor_name,
    MAX(vendor_phone) AS vendor_phone,
    customer_name,
    customer_email,
    customer_phone,
    city,
    STRING_AGG(DISTINCT equipment_requested, ',') AS equipment_list,
    STRING_AGG(dispatch_id::text, ',') AS all_dispatch_ids,
    MAX(start_date) AS start_date,
    MAX(end_date) AS end_date,
    MAX(vendor_priority) AS vendor_priority
FROM partners_dispatch
WHERE 
    dispatch_status = 'pending_vendor_contact'
    AND search_status = 'lead_captured'
    AND call_attempts < 2
    AND (call_result IS NULL OR call_result != 'Completed')
    AND customer_name IS NOT NULL
    AND customer_name != ''
    AND customer_phone IS NOT NULL
    AND customer_phone != ''
GROUP BY 
    vendor_email,
    customer_name,
    customer_email,
    customer_phone,
    city
ORDER BY MAX(vendor_priority) ASC, MAX(created_at) ASC;

UPDATE partners_dispatch 
SET 
  vendor_base_rate = {{ $json.vendor_rate }},
  markup_amount = {{ $json.markup_amount }},
  client_final_rate = {{ $json.client_final_rate }},
  dispatch_status = 'Available',
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE dispatch_id = '{{ $json.dispatch_id }}'::uuid
RETURNING dispatch_id, dispatch_status, customer_phone, equipment_requested;

UPDATE partners_dispatch
SET
  call_result = 'no_answer',
  last_call_at = NOW(),
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE dispatch_id = ANY(
  string_to_array('{{ $('Webhook').item.json.body.all_dispatch_ids }}', ',')::uuid[]
);

UPDATE partners_dispatch 
SET 
    call_attempts = call_attempts + 1,
    call_result = 'calling',
    last_call_at = NOW()
WHERE dispatch_id = ANY(
    string_to_array('{{ $json.all_dispatch_ids }}', ',')::uuid[]
);

UPDATE partners_dispatch
SET 
  dispatch_status = 'Cancelled',
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE 
  customer_phone = '{{ $('Webhook').item.json.body.customer_phone }}'
  AND equipment_requested = '{{ $json.equipment_requested }}'
  AND CAST(vendor_priority AS INTEGER) > CAST('{{ $('Webhook').item.json.body.vendor_priority }}' AS INTEGER)
  AND dispatch_status NOT IN ('Available', 'Cancelled')
RETURNING dispatch_id, dispatch_status, equipment_requested;

UPDATE partners_dispatch
SET
  dispatch_status = 'Unavailable',
  call_result = 'unavailable',
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE dispatch_id = ANY(
  string_to_array('{{ $('Webhook').item.json.body.all_dispatch_ids }}', ',')::uuid[]
);
